messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — want to align on the handshake/playbook for the upcoming private pilot. main concerns: cohort capacity, onboarding runway, and how we surface feedback to product decisions. 
Alex (Eng): 👍 timeline?
Priya (PM): Target kickoff 2026-05-18, 6-week engagement window per cohort. Need capacity plan for ~8 concurrent partners, each ~3k monthly tokens on avg.
Sam W (TPM): Can we surface a soft cap and autoscaling for spikes? we should avoid overcommitting GPUs for tiny cohorts.
Alex (Eng): We can reserve 2 dedicated nodes and a small burst pool. suggest policy: 2 reserved + 1 burst per 4 partners.
Devin (CS): For partner expectations — folks expect a named contact + 24h triage. recommend we add a single-thread support rota for the pilot (not full eng oncall).
Marta (Research): Feedback cadence: 1x weekly async survey + 2x structured sessions (mid and end). Also need prompt-run eval harness to track regressions.
Priya (PM): Agree. Proposed success criteria: 1) integration within 2 days of onboarding, 2) <5 critical bugs, 3) feature requests categorized and voted by partners, 4) quality regressions < 3% on eval set.
Alex (Eng): How do we collect logs + traces? want token-level cost + latency per route.
Sam W (TPM): Instrumentation plan: SDK will add a small wrapper that POSTs minimal metadata to our pilot telemetry endpoint. Not PII.
Devin (CS): Also need a simple failure escalation doc for partners (where to open tickets, expected triage time). I can draft.
Priya (PM): Owner assignments: onboarding doc — Devin. Integration templates — Alex. Eval harness + dashboard — Marta. Rollout policy + capacity — Sam.
Alex (Eng): For onboarding templates, I'll produce: sample SDK snippet, sample config yaml, and a minimal healthcheck.
Priya (PM): On recruitment: we should prioritize partners who can commit to weekly feedback + have a realistic integration surface (one route, <5 endpoints). Also prefer orgs with privacy needs for Private deployment testing.
Marta (Research): Suggest we recruit 2 integration partners (deep), 6 lightweight (breadth). That matches the 8 capacity.
Sam W (TPM): Timeline check: recruitment window 2 weeks, onboarding docs ready end of week, instrumentation shippable as feature flag.
Priya (PM): Can we gate launch on instrumentation working and 2 partners onboarded?
Alex (Eng): Yes — but we should allow a grace period to iterate on the SDK wrapper. set canary to 2 partners before opening to rest.
Devin (CS): I'll draft an onboarding checklist with accept criteria and share in this thread tomorrow.
Priya (PM): Notifications: @channel we'll send a one-pager and ask for volunteers to be primary contact for each partner.
onboarding-bot: New doc created: "pilot-onboarding-checklist.md" by Devin — https://redwood/docs/pilot-onboarding-checklist
Marta (Research): For feedback loop tooling: we need a shared Miro board + a short Google form that maps to product tags (bug, feature, usability, performance). I can set those up.
Priya (PM): Good. Also decide on weekly 30m sync format — demo + open issues — and an async summary with action items.
Alex (Eng): Quick note on capacity math: 8 partners * 3k tokens = 24k tokens/day? clarify units. we should model peak qps, ingress size, and KV cache patterns.
Sam W (TPM): I'll run a quick capacity model and post numbers by EOD.
Devin (CS): Risk log: potential regressions, onboarding friction, billing confusion. plan: clear billing flow + sample invoices.
Priya (PM): Great. Next steps: Sam posts capacity numbers, Devin shares onboarding checklist, Alex posts SDK snippet, Marta sets up feedback board. We'll reconvene Fri 2026-04-17 10:30 PT for final go/no-go.
Alex (Eng): I'll add a tiny healthcheck endpoint: `GET /_pilot_health` that returns {"status": "ok", "node": "id"}.
Marta (Research): Will add eval harness: weekly diff metrics + visualizations.
Devin (CS): Draft ready — sharing in #product-docs in 30m.
Priya (PM): Thanks all — this is compact but actionable. If anyone wants to be the backup contact for any partner, ping me. :rocket:
